q: Altitude is lost while thrust is acting to accelerate the plane from the 70 kts A/S back to 100 kts and plane drops below G/S.
The speed should remain close to 160 kts. Never let it get below 150 kts here.
2007, Peter D. Condon, Flying the Classic Learjet:

Suppose, for KBOS, aircraft with 90 kts or less final approach speed include all single engine general aviation aircraft and aircraft with 160 kts or greater final approach speed include all military fighter type aircraft.
